text:
Rina (PM): Heads-up from today's post-launch roundup: three follow-on items surfaced — incorrect autocomplete suggestions after feature flip, intermittent streaming cutouts on slow networks, and elevated token-cost variance for reranker queries. Need to decide hotfix vs next sprint.
Omar: autocomplete looks correctness-sensitive. Customer reported top suggestion that was unrelated to query. Likely scoring normalization regression after we merged the scoring shim.
Felix: streaming cutouts are ~100 dropped-chunks/min on low-bandwidth mobile; trace shows no server error, likely client reassembly. Filed #STREAM-402.
Tess (QA): token-cost variance: we've seen 20-60% higher token usage on some queries with the new reranker prompt; could be prompt-template expansion bug. Tagged #COST-77.
Rina (PM): proposal: must-fix = autocomplete (customer-facing relevance), urgent = streaming cutouts (impacts activation), backlog = token-cost variance (monitor + guardrails).
Omar: agree. For autocomplete I'll revert the scoring shim and run validation on the enterprise test set (500 queries). Revert ETA: 45m. Acceptance: top-1 relevance back to baseline > 95%.
Felix: for streaming, short-term mitigation: increase client chunk-retry timeout and add heartbeat. I'll prep an SDK patch and a server keepalive tweak. Canary target: beta users by EOD.
Tess (QA): I'll run targeted regression suites once revert patch lands and also add a token-usage monitor for reranker traffic.
infra-bot: scheduled canary rollback for scorer-shim on pool-2 at 02:15 UTC. Owners: Omar, Tess.
Rina (PM): timeline: autocomplete validated within 24h for affected customers or route them to previous scorer + credit. Streaming mitigation telemetry to show 30% reduction in dropouts in 72h. Token-cost: add alert threshold and observe for two cycles.
Omar: reopening canary ticket and will post results here.
Felix: SDK patch will include `--increase-retry-ms` flag for quick rollback.
Tess (QA): will post smoke test commands in this thread once ready.
Rina (PM): moving autocomplete & streaming into hotfix lane on the roadmap board. Token-cost stays in next-sprint watchlist. Thanks team.
